title: Quant profile multi-workload benchmarking and regression detector
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a reproducible, multi-workload benchmarking harness to evaluate quantization profiles (FP16, INT8, INT4 and mixed-precision) across realistic production load shapes and to detect regressions in latency (tokens/sec, p95) and quality. Output should include a per-workload Pareto frontier of latency vs. quality, an automated statistical regression detector, and an integration point with Console dashboards and Alerting. This ticket covers harness design, dataset selection for quality checks, regression detection algorithm, CI integration, and follow-up automation for suggested fallback rules.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can replay 3 representative workload classes (chat-heavy, short-completion API, long-sequence batch) with configurable sequence length distributions and burst/steady load shapes
Collects tokens/sec and p95 latency at 1s and 99th percentile granularity, and stores results to perf DB for side-by-side comparisons
Quality checks run automatically on a calibration suite (n=400 prompts) producing embedding-similarity AUC and top-k exact-match metrics; results are recorded per-quant-profile

Regression detector flags meaningful perf or quality regressions with confidence intervals (bootstrap) and opens a ticket when regression crosses threshold (perf drop >10% or quality delta >2% with p<0.05)
Console shows a per-model Pareto view (latency vs quality) with recommended default profiles for each workload class
CI job runs harness for PRs that modify runtimes/kernels and fails when regression is detected according to policy
Documentation and runbook for how to interpret results and apply automatic fallback policies are published in Confluence
tasks: Design harness API for workload shapes and prefix/KV cache toggles (Diego) - draft spec in doc link
Implement load generator with jittered Poisson bursts and steady RPS modes (ENG branch: github.com/redwood-inference/quant-harness#multiworkload)
Add metric collectors for tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies and cold-start timing, export to TSDB
Implement quality pipeline: run calibration prompts, compute sentence-embedding cosine, n-gram exact-match, and BLEU-like score for long-form outputs
Implement regression detector using bootstrap CI + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR for multiple comparisons
Integrate results into Console dataset and add Pareto plot endpoint
CI integration: PR gate job and nightly sweep job; add to infra-k8s cronjob
Create runbook + Confluence page and checklist for human sampling and triage
